scope: Count paths in an instrumented copy of real C; never use host timing as S3 WCET.
limitations: 64 banks per declared case; only 12288 case covers full output-offset period
Workers are sequential, DMA immediately completes and artificial clock always returns zero
Actual C output checked byte-for-byte after every bank
Rates assume sustained constant input sample rate and declared bank/slice pattern
No core binding, wall-clock performance, RF timing, idle/empty polling or interrupt model
